text:
anya: Quick UX pass from the compliance demo run-through. Found a few small clarity/a11y/copy things in Security > Data settings. Not urgent but would improve first impressions.

ron: Thanks, drop notes here.

anya: 1) Chip ordering confusion: header shows [region] then [encryption]. Users read this as a regional attribute. Proposal: move the encryption chip to the left of the region badge or change the visible label to `Encryption: Customer key (BYOK)` / `Encryption: Redwood key` so ownership is obvious.

maya: +1. For narrow widths keep short label like `Customer key (BYOK)` and show full wording in tooltip/accessible label.

anya: 2) Screen reader output is currently "chip, button" which lacks context. Recommend aria-label examples: `aria-label=\"Encryption: customer-managed key (BYOK). Press for key details.\"` for BYOK and `aria-label=\"Encryption: Redwood-managed key\"` for our keys. Also add aria-describedby pointing to a visually-hidden node that explains "ownership vs storage region." When details panel opens, set role=\"status\" on the hint text so SRs get an announcement.

ron: Good. Also ensure chip is keyboard-focusable (tabindex=0) and has an explicit focus style.

maya: 3) Focus ring / contrast: current outline is too faint. Minimum: 2px solid high-contrast color or use system focus token. Also fix tab order so the chip is focused before any tooltip action.

anya: 4) Region fallback copy: today we show a small "fallback" marker with no context. Users ask why retention differs. Suggest `Region: EU (fallback)` plus tooltip: "Data stored in EU fallback region due to capacity constraints; retention defaults may differ. See Data residency docs." Keep tooltip short for translations and include a link id for docs.

design-bot: Accessibility checklist: ensure audit table rows have role=row and cells role=cell. Add aria-sort on sortable headers and visible sort indicators.

anya: 5) Audit log / CSV exports: current logs use terse SCREAMING_SNAKE events. This breaks readability and translation. Recommend normalized export headers and sentence-case events. Example CSV suggestion to include timezone-explicit header:

Header: event_time_utc,event,user_email,details
Row: 2024-11-02T14:32:00Z,Key rotated,admin@example.com,Customer key rotated to version v3

This keeps CSVs human-readable and unambiguous across timezones. If we change header name keep a server-side alias for legacy `time` fields during a deprecation window.

maya: 6) Copy variants for UI vs accessible label: visible short text: `Customer key (BYOK)` or `Redwood key`. Tooltip/full label: `Encryption: Customer key (BYOK). Press for key details.` Keep punctuation minimal for translation.

ron: Action plan: Maya to mock two chip placements in Figma (left vs separated) and attach CSS snippet. Anya will draft accessible labels and hidden hint copy. I'll coordinate a docs screenshot update once wording lands.

i18n-bot: Flagged UX-2147 for translation impact and added note: "avoid long punctuation-heavy visible labels".

design-bot: Created task UX-2146: "chip ordering + a11y + audit export header" (labels: ux, a11y, compliance).

anya: Will run NVDA + VoiceOver checks once PRs are up. Thanks everyone — small changes but high signal for enterprise demos.
